verdict.rationale: The evidence shows no AI assistant built into Loops. What it documents is outside-in agent support: an MCP server, a CLI and installable skills so that external coding agents (e.g., Claude) can operate Loops. That is adjacent tooling, not an in-product assistant you can hand tasks to.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product
